popular.text: Do you know how bad your transition defense has to be for Klay Thompson to not even look at the rim on a wide-open look at 3 and instead pass it up for a dunk?" Thompson to Antetokounmpo, who passed up the Bucks' transition defenders, for a dunk. Heat 80, Bucks 50. 9:18 in Q3.
popular.author: Eric Nehm
popular.quoted_text: The other night I remarked something like, "Do you know how good of a shooter you have to be to have Giannis Antetokounmpo not even look at the rim on a 4-on-1 break and instead pass it to you behind the 3-point line?" Klay Thompson hit a 3 off that pass.

popular.text: FINAL: Heat 137, Bucks 130 - Antetokounmpo 27pts/14reb/9ast - Adebayo 26pts/4reb/2ast - Mitchell 24pts/2reb/6ast - Conwell 13pts/3reb - Thompson 13pts - Wiggins 11pts/3reb/3ast The Heat (9-6) have now won six straight games. They play again on Sunday vs. the Thunder.
